entry.title: HPE CEO Neri on Oracle Deal, AI Adoption and Earnings Outlook
entry.summary: HPE President and CEO Antonio Neri discusses the benefits of HPE's networking deal with Oracle and the company's earnings outlook. Speaking with Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech," Neri says he is seeing "huge growth" in enterprise AI adoption. (Source: Bloomberg)

entry.title: Saudi Arabia’s Humain Unveils AI Model Based on China’s MiniMax
entry.summary: Saudi Arabia’s artificial intelligence company Humain has built a national AI platform based on an open model from Chinese lab MiniMax Group Inc., joining a growing list of countries seeking tighter control of the increasingly important technology.

entry.title: Nvidia’s Huang Urges G20 to Speed AI Adoption as Key to Growth
